core_obligations: The authors combine a width-depth hard but quasipolynomial-size resolution family with XOR composition and a stifling gadget, using a new lifting argument to obtain general ResLin size-versus-depth lower bounds while retaining short ordinary resolution proofs. This differs from bottom-regular ResLin lower bounds and from hard Tseitin families without a short-resolution guarantee.
